# Alert

A message inside the page that informs, confirms, warns or reports a problem, without interrupting.

```tsx
import { Alert } from '@kafka/react'
```

## When to use it

- To tell the reader something about the page they are on: a schedule change, a confirmed payment, a form error summary.
- With one action when the reader can do something about it.

## When not to

- When the reader must answer before going on: use ConfirmDialog.
- For a message that disappears by itself: a message that vanishes can't be read at the reader's pace.
- Stacking several alerts: group them or keep the most important.

## Examples

### Tones

Every tone carries an icon and a border, so none depends on colour. Use `urgent` only when the reader must hear it now.

```tsx
<div className="flex max-w-xl flex-col gap-4">
  <Alert tone="info" title="Inscripciones abiertas">Quedan 8 cupos para el taller de poesía.</Alert>
  <Alert tone="success" title="Pago confirmado">Recibimos tu comprobante de Nequi.</Alert>
  <Alert tone="warning" title="Últimos cupos">El taller cierra el viernes.</Alert>
  <Alert tone="danger" urgent title="No pudimos enviar tu inscripción">Revisa tu conexión e inténtalo de nuevo.</Alert>
</div>
```

### Dismissible, with an action

The close button is 44 px. The page decides where focus goes after it closes.

```tsx
<div className="max-w-xl"><Dismissible /></div>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tone` | `AlertTone` | `'info'` | The meaning. Every tone carries an icon and a border, so colour is never the only signal. |
| `title` | `ReactNode` |  | A short heading in the tone's colour. |
| `Icon` | `IconType` |  | Replaces the tone's icon. |
| `urgent` | `boolean` | `false` | Use `role="alert"` so screen readers interrupt and read it now. Only for what the reader must hear immediately. |
| `onDismiss` | `() => void` |  | Shows a 44 px close button and calls this when it is pressed. The component does not manage focus afterwards. |
| `action` | `ReactNode` |  | A button or link at the end, for the one thing the reader can do about it. |
| …rest | `HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>` | | Everything else is passed to the underlying element. |

## Accessibility

- **Polite by default:** `role="status"` is announced when it changes, without interrupting. `urgent` switches to `role="alert"`; use it only for what the reader must hear now.
- **Not by colour alone:** every tone has an icon and a border in the status colour (3:1 against the page). Title 4.5:1 on its tint, body text 4.5:1, in both modes.
- The close button is 44 px and named by the provider's `close` label. The alert does not move focus; the page decides where it goes after it closes.

## Content

- Title in a few words that say what happened; the body says what to do next. No full stop in the title.
